summary: Swanwick Military East will offer air traffic service only to highest priority traffic, with no guaranteed service.
text:
SWANWICK (MIL) EAST WILL ONLY BE ABLE TO OFFER AN ATS
TO HIGHEST PRIORITY TRAFFIC AND A SERVICE CANNOT BE GUARANTEED. 
SQUADRONS ARE REQUESTED TO ENGAGE WITH 78 SQN PLANS AT 
THE EARLIEST OPPORTUNITY.
